cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.description: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.description: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.description: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

cards.name: Shining Volcanion
cards.description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.description: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Shining Mew
cards.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Latios
cards.description: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Shining Jirachi
cards.description: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.description: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.description: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

cards.name: Shining Rayquaza
cards.description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Shining Arceus
cards.description: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Shining Genesect
cards.description: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
